what: Proposed mktemp-backed enumeration does not handle temp-file allocation failure under set -e
scenario_or_breakage: If TMPDIR points at a missing or unwritable directory, mktemp exits non-zero before the planned find failure branch runs; cleanup aborts without emitting the required removal-count KVs, contradicting the planned cleanup still exits 0 fail-safe
suggested_fix: Guard each mktemp call: on allocation failure, emit a larch_err warning, skip that pass with count 0, and continue to the next pass; or fall back to /tmp before deciding to skip
